column7:
Reduction in provision of
₹155.57 lakh was the net
effect of increase of
₹15.97 lakh and decrease
by re-appropriation of
₹15.97 lakh and surrender
of ₹155.57 lakh. Increase
was attributed to need of
additional amounts in
office expenses,
maintenance and fuel of
van, contract services and
other allowances.
Reduction in provision by
re-appropriation of ₹13.34
lakh was attributed to
anticipated saving.
Reasons for reduction in
provision by re-
appropriation of
₹2.63.lakh and Surrender
have not been intimated
(July 2024).
